name: lattice-loader

frames.best_why: All three status rows are crisp, including the finished green row and the freshly started timers.

tagline: Rows of tiny dot lattices tick beside labels as an agent works.
summary: Compact status rows for background tasks: a grid of cells pulses in patterns beside a label and a running stopwatch, then switches to a green done mark when the row finishes.
appearance: Three stacked rows on a dark card, each led by a small square grid of round dots, followed by a bright label and a smaller grey timer. The finished row's dots turn green and its timer stays fixed while the others count up.
behaviour: The dots light in a travelling pattern while the timer beside them counts every tenth of a second. On completion the lattice fades out, green dots snap into a check-like mark and the timer freezes.
demo_content: Research agent card with rows: Searching 42 sources, Reading pricing pages, Compared 6 competitors.
use_when: An AI agent or background job needs a compact, readable status line with a timer.
avoid_when: The dots are tiny and low-contrast at default size, so the animation is easy to miss from a distance.
customise: Label, done and error text, status, pattern (named or a custom cell map), grid size, shape, colours, cell size, gap, font size, step, idle opacity, glow, timer and elapsed are props.
weight_why: A few dozen spans with CSS opacity loops and a hundred-millisecond timer; negligible.

a11y.note: A status role announces the label, but the ticking timer is aria-hidden so intermediate seconds are never spoken.

issues: The working dots are very small and dim against the dark card, so the moving pattern is easy to miss.
polish_why: Tidy rows and a satisfying done mark; the tiny dim dots are easy to overlook.
title: Lattice Loader
